page.layout: One page of text. Running head at the top centre. Below it, a heading and a two-column list of the Salutation. Then a heading and a list of the cardinal numbers. Then a heading, a date line and a Hungarian paragraph, with the last line set short and right-aligned.

main_text.head: I. Salutatio Angelica Hungarice.
II. Numeri cardinales.
main_text.l: Vnû, duo, tria, qtuor[?], qnq[?], sex,septem,
main_text.head: III. Oratio Dominica Hungarice, transcripta ex Psalterio Hungarico, edito ab Alberto Molnar, Herborna 1607.
main_text.p: Mi Atyánc ki vagy az mennyekben, szen-telesséc megá te neved. jöyön el az te orsz ágod:Legyen megá te akaratod,mint az menyben, ugy it ez földönnis. Az mi mindennapi kenyerünket add meg nékünc ma. Es boczásd megaz mi vétkeinket, miképpen miis megboczátunc azoknac az kic mi ellenűnc vétkeztenec. Es ne vigy minket az késértethe:

page.notes: Long s is printed as a form resembling f or s in several words (e.g. "sch", "sz"); transcribed as plain s. The Hungarian lines are in a mixed column layout; cell splits in the first list are inferred from the printed alignment. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "assonialatock", "giumoltsche", "hatt,het", "qtuor", "qnq". The date 1607 is part of the third heading as printed on its own line. No page number, catchword or signature is printed.
